what: rrf_k sweep over the shipped ranker promotion-gate fixture
why: Establish whether the fixture that gates ranker promotion can detect the fusion effect the 2026-07-29/30 retrieval campaign identified as the largest available win.
finding: rrf_k is completely inert. Every candidate appears in both retrieval legs (2-4 candidates per query), so pool recall is 1.0 by construction and the rank-discount constant cannot reorder anything.
consequence: This fixture was RANK_FIT_DEFAULT_BENCHMARK in src/kb/kb_ranker_fit.c with RANK_FIT_LIFT_EPSILON=1e-6. It could not detect a fusion regression and could not distinguish the rrf_k=10 vs rrf_k=60 effect the 10k-query campaign measured. Any model whose mean NDCG@5 rose by one part in a million was promoted to production.
resolution: Gate rewritten 2026-07-30: minimum query count (RANK_FIT_MIN_BENCH_QUERIES=30, else 'benchmark_underpowered'), lift epsilon raised to 1e-3, and a paired per-query win/loss majority now required. See docs/proposals/pending/learning-to-rank-from-interactions.md.

replay_tool_reproduction.note: Confirms tool and fixture are intact and match the committed baseline_result.json; the fixture is simply too small to measure ranking quality.
